title: A definition, as read
description: What GET /v1/agents/{key}/definition answers: the definition last put, as it was sent, and the tools it names that offer nothing yet.

missing.description: The tools the definition names that offer nothing yet, such as server/* for an MCP server its owner has not added. Each offers its tools once what it names is there, without the definition being put again.

definition.instructions: Answer customers' questions about their orders.
